A:by-zombie-katy.now: Katy survives the outbreak with Shang-Chi. When Wanda's spell sweeps the world, her fate is left unknown.
A:by-zombie-katy.text: In episode 4, after surviving the outbreak with Shang-Chi, Katy is killed by the zombie horde in the battle to defend the Infinity Hulk.

A:by-zombie-peter-parker.now: In Paris, Peter defends the Infinity Hulk until the zombie Wasp pins him down. As Wanda's spell sweeps the world, his fate is left unknown.
A:by-zombie-peter-parker.text: In Paris, Peter defends the Infinity Hulk until the zombie Wasp pins him down, and the horde kills him in the battle.

A:by-zombie-scott-lang.now: Rescued from Wakanda with Peter, he later defends the Infinity Hulk. Zombies crack his jar as Wanda's spell hits, and his fate is unknown.
A:by-zombie-scott-lang.text: Rescued from Wakanda with Peter, he later defends the Infinity Hulk, and the zombie horde kills him in the battle.

C:by-embers-of-genesis.now: In season 1, Nebula and Star-Lord T'Challa's Ravagers steal the Embers.
C:by-embers-of-genesis.text: In season 1, Nebula and Star-Lord T'Challa's Ravagers steal the Embers, and Nebula feeds some to Cull Obsidian, overgrowing Knowhere as they escape.

T:fox-black-tom.now: Black Tom rides in the prison convoy with Russell and Deadpool, and Cable kills him when he attacks it.
T:fox-black-tom.text: Black Tom rides in the prison convoy with Russell, and Cable shoots him dead in his cell when he attacks it.

A:fox-weasel.now: Weasel runs Sister Margaret's bar and helps Deadpool find Ajax.
A:fox-weasel.text: Weasel runs Sister Margaret's bar, and after talking with him, the scarred Wade decides to hunt Ajax as Deadpool.

A:fox-blind-al.now: Blind Al is still Wade's roommate as he grieves Vanessa.
A:fox-blind-al.text: Wade visits Blind Al as he grieves Vanessa, and she tries to get him to move on with his life.

A:fox-anim-sunspot.now: In episode 3, Roberto is saved from the Friends of Humanity and joins the X-Men.
A:fox-anim-sunspot.text: In episode 1, the X-Men save Roberto from the Friends of Humanity and take him to the mansion.

T:fox-anim-danger.now: In episode 16, she hijacks a jet to confront Xavier on Genosha, and Xavier, Jean, Bishop and Polaris defeat her.
T:fox-anim-danger.text: In episode 16, she hijacks a jet to confront Xavier on Genosha and bests the X-Men there, until Polaris, urged on by Xavier, destroys her.

A:fox-wolverine.now: A cage fighter in Canada, Logan saves Rogue from Sabretooth and joins the X-Men to rescue her from Magneto.
A:fox-wolverine.text: A cage fighter in Canada, Logan is saved with Rogue from Sabretooth by Cyclops and Storm. He joins the X-Men to rescue her from Magneto.

A:fox-anim-cyclops.now: In episode 12, Scott and Jean help Nathan escape Apocalypse's followers in the future, then return to the 1990s.
A:fox-anim-cyclops.text: In episode 12, Scott and Jean stay in 3960 A.D. with Nathan and are captured with him by Apocalypse's followers. Rescued by the other X-Men, they are sent back to the 1990s by Nathan.

A:fox-anim-jean-grey.now: In episode 12, in the future, she helps Nathan escape Apocalypse's followers, then returns to the 1990s.
A:fox-anim-jean-grey.text: In episode 12, Jean and Scott stay in 3960 A.D. with Nathan and are captured with him by Apocalypse's followers. Rescued by the other X-Men, they are sent back to the 1990s by Nathan.

A:fox-anim-dazzler.now: In episode 40, the Hellfire Club targets the singer Dazzler, and the X-Men step in.
A:fox-anim-dazzler.text: In episode 40, the Inner Circle Club targets the singer Dazzler, and the X-Men step in.

A:fox-anim-magneto.now: In episode 10, Magneto plunges Earth into a blackout from Asteroid M, then vanishes in time when the asteroid explodes.
A:fox-anim-magneto.text: In episode 10, having plunged Earth into a blackout, Magneto makes his stand on Asteroid M, then vanishes in time when the asteroid explodes.

A:fox-anim-genosha.now: In episode 5, Genosha's mutant council asks Magneto and Rogue to lead it, and the island joins the UN.
A:fox-anim-genosha.text: In episode 5, Genosha's mutant council asks Magneto to lead it, and he agrees if Rogue leads with him, as the island joins the UN.

T:fox-anim-sabretooth.now: In episode 6, Sabretooth stalks Wolverine and clashes with the X-Men again and again.
T:fox-anim-sabretooth.text: In episode 6, Sabretooth follows Wolverine to the Arctic, burns the Inuit camp that took him in and takes the villagers captive, until Wolverine beats him and he falls into a chasm.

C:fox-anim-sentinels.now: In season 4, Master Mold's head sends Sentinels to capture Xavier, Trask and Gyrich, until Trask blows up their base.
C:fox-anim-sentinels.text: In season 4, Master Mold's surviving head has its Sentinels kidnap Trask and Gyrich to build it a new body, until Morph drives a spike through its head and shuts it down.

T:st-johann-fennhoff.now: In episode 8, Peggy stops him, and he ends up in a cell next to Arnim Zola.
T:st-johann-fennhoff.text: In episode 8, Sousa captures him while Peggy talks Howard down, and he ends up in a cell next to Arnim Zola.

A:st-mike-peterson.now: In episode 41, Deathlok secretly works for Coulson and helps take down HYDRA's Dr. List.
A:st-mike-peterson.text: In episode 41, Deathlok, secretly working for Coulson, has been captured while hunting HYDRA's Dr. List, and Coulson's team frees him from List's base.

A:st-jemma-simmons.now: In episode 3, Simmons and Fitz upgrade Elena's tracking watch, and a question from Elena about living together gets Simmons thinking.
A:st-jemma-simmons.text: In episode 3, Simmons checks Elena's pulse while Fitz upgrades her tracking watch, and Elena's suggestion that they look for an apartment gets Simmons hooked on the idea.

T:st-deathlok.now: In episode 18, Garrett turns Mike into the cyborg Deathlok, using his son as leverage.
T:st-deathlok.text: In episode 21, Garrett turns Mike into the cyborg Deathlok, using his son as leverage.

T:st-nystrom-larsen.now: In episode 8, Jakob and Petra use a piece of the Asgardian Berserker staff to hunt down its other pieces, until Ward and May beat them.

C:odium.now: In season 5, Kasius drives fighters mad with odium and finally takes it himself.
C:odium.text: In season 5, Kasius forces his servant Tye to drink odium and sends him after the team, then finally takes it himself.

C:infusion-chamber.now: In season 5, Hale's HYDRA infuses Ruby with gravitonium in Whitehall's particle-infusion chamber.
C:infusion-chamber.text: In season 5, Ruby turns on her mother, and Strucker infuses her with gravitonium in Whitehall's particle-infusion chamber.

A:riri-williams.now: Riri's vibranium detector makes her Namor's target, and Shuri and Okoye bring her to Wakanda. She builds a suit and fights for Wakanda against Talokan, then goes back to MIT without it.
A:riri-williams.text: Riri's vibranium detector makes her Namor's target, and his warriors take her and Shuri to Talokan until Nakia frees them. She builds a suit and fights for Wakanda against Talokan, then goes back to MIT without it.

C:ironheart-armor.text: Namor's warriors ambush Riri on the bridge, and Namora and Attuma throw her suit into the water below.

C:red-guardian-suit.now: Alexei squeezes back into his old Red Guardian suit for the raid on the Red Room.
C:red-guardian-suit.text: At Melina's farm, Alexei squeezes back into his old Red Guardian suit, and he is wearing it when Dreykov's agents take him to the Red Room, where he fights Taskmaster.

A:howard-stark.now: At Camp Lehigh in 1970, Howard talks about fatherhood with a disguised Steve as his first child is on the way.
A:howard-stark.text: At Camp Lehigh in 1970, Howard talks about fatherhood with a disguised Tony as his first child is on the way.

T:hydra.now: In episode 30, in 1945, Peggy Carter's SSR raids HYDRA's last base in Austria and arrests its commander, Werner Reinhardt.
T:hydra.text: In episode 23, in 1945, Peggy Carter's SSR raids HYDRA's last base in Austria and arrests its commander, Werner Reinhardt.

A:phil-coulson.now: In episode 44, Director Coulson rebuilds S.H.I.E.L.D. in secret and makes peace with the rival 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.'
A:phil-coulson.text: In episode 42, Director Coulson rebuilds S.H.I.E.L.D. in secret and makes peace with the rival 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.'

A:monica-rambeau.now: In episode 7, back from the Blip, Monica enters the Westview Hex for S.W.O.R.D. and gains powers.
A:monica-rambeau.text: In episode 7, defying Director Hayward, Monica forces her way back into the Westview Hex and gains powers.

A:goose.now: Goose and her kittens swallow the crew of Fury's space station to save them.
A:goose.text: Goose lays a litter of Flerken kittens on Fury's space station, and Fury uses them to swallow the crew and carry them to safety. Goose then settles on Earth with Carol.

T:st-vladimir-ranskahov.now: In episode 6, Vladimir blames Daredevil for his brother's death, then learns Fisk was the killer.
T:st-vladimir-ranskahov.text: In episode 5, Vladimir blames Daredevil for his brother's death, then learns Fisk was the killer.

T:st-carl-hoffman.now: In episode 9, Hoffman kills his partner Blake on Fisk's orders, then flees for his life.
T:st-carl-hoffman.text: In episode 8, Hoffman poisons his partner Blake in hospital on Fisk's orders, then blames the masked man for his death.

T:st-jasper-evans.now: In episode 2, Inmate Jasper Evans stabs Fisk on Fisk's own orders, getting him moved out of prison.

A:christine-palmer.now: Christine helps Strange recover, then saves his life when he is stabbed in astral form.
A:christine-palmer.text: Christine helps Strange after his crash, then operates to save his life when a zealot stabs him, while his astral form fights on.

C:agamotto.now: In 2012, the Ancient One gives Bruce her Time Stone. Steve later travels back to return it.
C:agamotto.after: Thanos uses the stones' own power to destroy them, reducing the Time Stone to atoms.

C:cloak.now: On Ebony Maw's ship, it slips free to help rescue Strange, and later turns to dust with him in the Snap.
C:cloak.text: It follows Strange aboard Ebony Maw's ship and helps Tony and Peter rescue him, and later turns to dust with him in the Snap.

A:nicepool.now: Following Dogpool into Wade's world, he warns them of the Deadpool variants, and Wade uses him as a shield until he is killed.
A:nicepool.text: Arriving in Wade's world with the Deadpool variants, he chases Dogpool to Wade and Logan and warns them of the variants, and Wade uses him as a shield until he is killed.

T:gargantos.now: Gargantos chases America Chavez through New York until Strange and Wong kill it.
T:gargantos.text: Gargantos chases America Chavez through New York until Strange, fighting beside Wong, kills it with a lamppost through its eye.

A:sersi.now: Sersi lives in London as a museum teacher until a Deviant attack reunites her with Ikaris and Sprite. Chosen by Ajak, she learns Earth is a Celestial's egg and gathers the Eternals to stop the Emergence.
A:sersi.text: Sersi lives in London as a museum teacher until a Deviant attack reunites her with Ikaris. Chosen by Ajak, she learns Earth is a Celestial's egg and gathers the Eternals to stop the Emergence.

T:the-lion.now: In episode 1, the Lion rules Crete like a god and raids for slaves with stolen Wakandan tech.
T:the-lion.text: In episode 1, the Lion rules his own pirate kingdom like a god and raids Crete for captives with stolen Wakandan tech.

A:groot.now: Restored, Groot fights in the final battle.

T:karja.now: Karja leads the Orgoscope's guards and fires on the Guardians when he sees through their disguises.
T:karja.text: Karja leads the Orgoscope's guards. When Drax and Mantis are spotted through their disguises, he shoots Drax.

T:raza.now: Raza brings the wrecked armor to Obadiah Stane, who paralyzes him and has him killed.
T:raza.text: Raza brings the wrecked armor to Obadiah Stane, who paralyzes him with a sonic taser and has his men killed.

A:christine-everhart.now: Christine covers the Stark Expo, where Justin Hammer shows off his drones.
A:christine-everhart.text: In Monaco, Christine interviews Justin Hammer for Vanity Fair, then leaves him to chase the story when Tony enters the Grand Prix.

A:happy-hogan.now: Happy watches over Peter Parker for Tony, but he is busy moving the Avengers' gear out of Stark Tower and misses the boy's warnings.
A:happy-hogan.text: Happy watches over Peter Parker for Tony, but he is busy moving the Avengers' gear out of Avengers Tower and misses the boy's warnings.

T:trevor-slattery.now: Trevor, kept by Wenwu as a jester, helps Shang-Chi reach Ta Lo, then goes off on his own.
T:trevor-slattery.text: Trevor, kept by Wenwu as a jester, helps Shang-Chi reach Ta Lo, then stays there with Morris.

A:trevor-slattery.now: Held by Wenwu for years, Trevor befriends Shang-Chi with his hundun Morris and helps him fight.
A:trevor-slattery.text: Held by Wenwu for years, Trevor befriends Shang-Chi, and he and his hundun Morris guide him to Ta Lo.

A:felix-blake.now: Blake hunts Bennie and Claire after they steal a Chitauri gun, then recruits them to S.H.I.E.L.D.
A:felix-blake.text: Blake and Sitwell are assigned to recover a Chitauri gun that Bennie and Claire use to rob banks. Sitwell recruits the couple to S.H.I.E.L.D. instead, and Claire becomes Blake's assistant.

C:st-igh-drug.now: After Simpson is killed, Trish uses the IGH enhancer she took from him and grows addicted to it.
C:st-igh-drug.text: In episode 9, after Simpson is killed, Trish grows addicted to the IGH enhancer she took from him and uses it up.

T:anton-mogart.now: In episode 3, when Anton Mogart turns on Marc and Layla over a sarcophagus, Marc spears him through the chest.
T:anton-mogart.text: In episode 3, when Anton Mogart turns on Marc and Layla over a sarcophagus and charges Layla on horseback, Marc hits him in the back with a crescent dart.

A:st-james-lucas.now: In episode 8, Luke protects his father, Pastor James Lucas, from Bushmaster's men, and the two begin to reconcile.
A:st-james-lucas.text: In episode 9, Luke protects his father, Pastor James Lucas, from Bushmaster's men, and the two begin to reconcile.

T:titania.now: Titania turns up at the Intelligencia summit to fight Jen and is arrested.
T:titania.text: In episode 9, Titania crashes the Intelligencia event at Emil's retreat, then films Todd's arrest for her fans and greets Daredevil.

A:jiang-li.now: Jiang Li leaves Ta Lo to marry Wenwu, and is killed by the Iron Gang while he is away.
A:jiang-li.text: Ying Li leaves Ta Lo to marry Wenwu, and is killed by the Iron Gang while he is away.

T:saracen.now: In episode 7, Saracen joins Emil's group therapy and tells Jen that Josh just wanted her blood.
T:saracen.text: In episode 7, Saracen joins Emil's group therapy, where he offers to suck the blood of Josh, the man who stopped texting Jen.

A:j-jonah-jameson.now: In episode 25, Jameson talks over his new intern Betty Brant when she defends Peter, and keeps calling him the Spider-Menace.
A:j-jonah-jameson.text: In episode 8, Jameson talks over his new intern Betty Brant when she defends Peter, and keeps calling him the Spider-Menace.

A:karen.now: Peter unlocks his suit's AI, names her Karen, and she helps him stop the Vulture.
A:karen.text: Peter unlocks his suit's AI and names her Karen. She helps him at the Washington Monument and on the Staten Island Ferry, until Tony takes the suit away.

T:damage-control.now: Using the Hand as guards, Damage Control experiments on telepaths, until Spider-Man frees Jean Grey and the department comes under investigation.
T:damage-control.text: Using the Hand as guards, Damage Control experiments on telepaths, until Jean Grey breaks loose at its Roosevelt Island facility. After Spider-Man calms her, the department comes under investigation.

T:st-gideon-malick.now: In episode 56, Malick brings Hive back to Earth to lead HYDRA.
T:st-gideon-malick.text: In episode 54, Malick brings Hive back to Earth to lead HYDRA.

C:scepter.now: In 2012, Steve takes it from HYDRA agents inside S.H.I.E.L.D. in a Stark Tower elevator. He returns it once the stones have been used.
C:scepter.text: In 2012, Steve takes it from HYDRA agents inside S.H.I.E.L.D. in a Stark Tower elevator. He returns the Mind Stone once the stones have been used.

C:trick-arrows.now: LARPers retrieve Clint's trick arrows for Kate, who uses them to take down Kingpin.
C:trick-arrows.text: The LARPers get Clint's trick arrows back from the police. Later, Clint and Kate make a new batch, and Kate uses them to take down Kingpin.

A:thor.now: Thor gets the Reality Stone in 2013 and fights Thanos. Afterward, he names Valkyrie king and leaves with the Guardians.
A:thor.text: In 2013, Thor reclaims Mjolnir while Rocket takes the Reality Stone, and he later fights Thanos. Afterward, he names Valkyrie king and leaves with the Guardians.

T:fenris.now: Hela raises Fenris from the dead, and the Hulk wrestles it off the Rainbow Bridge into the sea.
T:fenris.text: Hela raises Fenris from the dead, and the Hulk fights it into the sea below the Rainbow Bridge, then knocks it over the edge of Asgard to its death.

T:tyler-hayward.now: Monica Rambeau exposes Hayward, and he is arrested.
T:tyler-hayward.text: In episode 9, Hayward shoots at Wanda's sons in Westview, but Monica shields them and Darcy rams his Humvee with a food truck. He is then arrested.

T:pr-bloodpack.now: Reapers and sunlight kill the squad one by one, and Nyssa, the last, dies in the sunrise.
T:pr-bloodpack.text: Reapers and sunlight kill the squad one by one, Blade cuts Reinhardt down, and Nyssa, the last, dies in the sunrise.

A:pr-st-chantelle.now: In episode 17, Chantelle reads a veve for Tyrone before Andre kills her by filling her with sadness.
A:pr-st-chantelle.text: In episode 17, Chantelle reads Andre's veve and tells him he could become a Loa, but he kills her by filling her with sadness.

T:sv-green-goblin-asm2.now: Ousted from Oscorp, he frees Electro from Ravencroft to break into the company. Harry injects the spider venom, dons Oscorp armor and becomes the Green Goblin.
T:sv-green-goblin-asm2.text: Ousted from Oscorp, he frees Electro from Ravencroft to break into the company. Harry forces Menken to inject him with the spider venom, dons Oscorp armor and becomes the Green Goblin.

C:sv-ssm-goblin-glider.now: In season 2, the true Goblin, Norman Osborn, flies it until his final battle with Spider-Man.

T:sv-butane-yfnsm.now: In episode 2, Butane burns down a building as part of an insurance scam. Spider-Man beats him and finds a strange symbol on his gear.

C:sv-yfnsm-octavius-tech.now: After Otto's arrest, his technology goes to Oscorp, and a gas made from it gives Lonnie Lincoln rock-hard skin.
C:sv-yfnsm-octavius-tech.text: After Otto's arrest, Oscorp seizes his technology, and when the 110th attacks the convoy, a vial of his Diox-3 gas gives Lonnie rock-hard skin.
